ai_summary: The Anup Engineering Limited has declared a final dividend of Rs. 12/- per share for FY2025-26, reflecting solid financial performance and a strong international market presence with 48.2% export turnover from its metal product manufacturing. However, key takeaways from their Business Responsibility & Sustainability Report include a rising permanent employee turnover rate (20% in FY25-26) and significant gender diversity issues, notably zero female representation in Key Management Personnel and among "other than permanent" workers. These factors, alongside the standalone BRSR not extending to its wholly-owned subsidiary, highlight potential areas for improvement in human capital management and integrated sustainability governance.
